name: Corner Penthouse
author: Companion Intelligence
style: A white-rendered penthouse pavilion with a deep flat roof overhang and floor-to-ceiling glass stands at the corner of a two-storey stone podium on a city street, a corner shop, a bike store, two flats and a stair lobby beneath it; the podium roof is a stone-floored terrace wrapping the pavilion behind glass rails, reached from the pavement by one long garden stair or by the private stair from the lobby, and the penthouse apartment inside is a long living room with a hearth, an island kitchen, a primary suite, two further bedrooms, an office and a book-lined nook
